class.name: NNBTRunHostedRoot
class.brief_description: Runs a nested AI root ([NNBTRoot], [NNSTRoot], [NNHTNRoot], or [NNAgent]) as a behaviour tree task.
class.description: Place any Noodle Nodes root as a child of this leaf to run it as part of a behaviour tree. This leaf activates the hosted root when the step starts, ticks it with the tree's delta, returns [constant NNBTNodes.RUNNING] until the hosted root finishes (mapping its result to [constant NNBTNodes.SUCCESS] or [constant NNBTNodes.FAILURE]), and deactivates it on completion or interrupt. Use this to embed a state tree, HTN planner, sub-behaviour tree, or utility agent inside a behaviour tree branch. Note that a hosted [NNAgent] never finishes on its own, so it runs until interrupted.
